extraction_notes: Datasheet table values preserve MIN, Type, and MAX semantics through source_kind; SI conversions were applied for mOhm, pF, nC, and uA values.

Figures 1 through 6 on p. 4 were digitized from the plotted traces only. Figure 2 explicitly labels 25 degC and 125 degC transfer curves; Figure 4 explicitly labels 25 degC and 150 degC diode curves. Other typical figures do not state temperature.
The datasheet provides no VDS value for the Figure 2 transfer curves, so that condition is recorded as not stated rather than inferred.
No separate RthJC value is published; only junction-to-ambient thermal resistance is shown on p. 1 and it is not part of the strict extraction schema.
